question_text: Can we use Genie One with PHI data?
answer_text: SELECT review_id, feature_name, is_phi_eligible, blocking_reason FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.v_feature_phi_eligibility WHERE feature_name ILIKE '%Genie One%'

question_text: Is Unity Catalog approved for PHI?
answer_text: SELECT review_id, feature_name, is_phi_eligible, blocking_reason FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.v_feature_phi_eligibility WHERE feature_name ILIKE '%Unity Catalog%'

question_text: Is the SQL Server connector PHI-eligible?
answer_text: SELECT review_id, feature_name, is_phi_eligible, blocking_reason FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.v_feature_phi_eligibility WHERE feature_name ILIKE '%SQL Server%'

question_text: Which features are approved for PHI?
answer_text: SELECT review_id, feature_name FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.v_feature_phi_eligibility WHERE is_phi_eligible

question_text: How many features are PHI-eligible?
answer_text: SELECT MEASURE(phi_eligible_count) AS phi_eligible FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.mv_trb_reviews

question_text: Which reviews are pending a TRB decision?
answer_text: SELECT review_id, feature_name FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.reviews WHERE current_trb_status = 'Under Review'

question_text: What open conditions does Serverless compute have?
answer_text: SELECT c.condition_id, c.condition_title, c.verification_status FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.approval_conditions c JOIN serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.reviews r ON c.review_id = r.review_id WHERE c.verification_status <> 'Closed' AND r.feature_name ILIKE '%Serverless compute%'

question_text: What open conditions does Genie One have?
answer_text: SELECT c.condition_id, c.condition_title, c.verification_status FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.approval_conditions c JOIN serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.reviews r ON c.review_id = r.review_id WHERE c.verification_status <> 'Closed' AND r.feature_name ILIKE '%Genie One%'

question_text: How many approval conditions are still open?
answer_text: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_conditions FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.approval_conditions WHERE verification_status <> 'Closed'

question_text: Why was Kafka-compatible APIs rejected?
answer_text: SELECT review_id, feature_name, current_trb_status, decision_rationale FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.reviews WHERE feature_name ILIKE '%Kafka%'

question_text: What did the TRB decide at the 2026-06-16 meeting?
answer_text: SELECT review_id, feature_name, current_trb_status FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.reviews WHERE decision_date = DATE '2026-06-16'

question_text: What is the TRB approval rate by domain?
answer_text: SELECT domain, MEASURE(approval_rate_pct) AS approval_rate_pct FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.mv_trb_reviews GROUP BY ALL

question_text: How many reviews does each domain have?
answer_text: SELECT domain, MEASURE(review_count) AS reviews FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.mv_trb_reviews GROUP BY ALL

question_text: What is the average number of days from submission to TRB decision?
answer_text: SELECT MEASURE(avg_days_to_decision) AS avg_days FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.mv_trb_reviews

question_text: Which exceptions were denied?
answer_text: SELECT exception_id, review_id, exception_status FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.exceptions WHERE exception_status = 'Denied'

question_text: Which pending reviews came from Clinical Analytics?
answer_text: SELECT review_id, feature_name FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.reviews WHERE current_trb_status = 'Under Review' AND requesting_business_unit = 'Clinical Analytics'

question_text: Which HIPAA controls are mapped to Customer-managed keys?
answer_text: SELECT m.control_id, m.control_name FROM serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.control_mappings m JOIN serverless_stable_swv01_catalog.trb.reviews r ON m.review_id = r.review_id WHERE r.feature_name ILIKE '%Customer-managed keys%' AND m.control_framework = 'HIPAA-Security-Rule'
